--- title: "Quick Start: End-to-End Classification Experiment" description: "Walk through the core iter8ml workflow — generate data, configure experiment, train models, inspect leaderboard, export champion." date: today format: html: self-contained: true embed-resources: true code-fold: true code-tools: true --- This notebook walks through the core **iter8ml** workflow: 1. Generate (or load) a dataset 2. Configure an experiment 3. Run multi-model training with cross-validation 4. Inspect the leaderboard and registry 5. Export the champion model ## 1. Generate Synthetic Data ::: {#generate-data .cell cache='true' execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import numpy as np import polars as pl from sklearn.datasets import make_classification X, y = make_classification( n_samples=2000, n_features=20, n_informative=10, n_redundant=3, random_state=42, ) df = pl.DataFrame({f"feat_{i}": X[:, i] for i in range(X.shape[1])}) df = df.with_columns(target=pl.Series(y)) print(f"Dataset shape: {df.shape} | Target balance: {df['target'].mean():.2%} positive class") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Dataset shape: (2000, 21) | Target balance: 50.15% positive class ``` ::: ::: ::: {#cell-data-preview .cell fig-height='4' fig-width='10' execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4)) counts = np.bincount(y) axes[0].bar(["Class 0", "Class 1"], counts, color=["#4C72B0", "#DD8452"]) axes[0].set_title("Class Distribution") axes[0].set_ylabel("Count") for i, c in enumerate(counts): axes[0].text(i, c + 20, str(c), ha="center", fontsize=10) corrs = np.corrcoef(X, y.reshape(-1, 1), rowvar=False)[-1, :-1] top_idx = np.argsort(np.abs(corrs))[::-1][:10] colors = ["#C44E52" if corrs[i] < 0 else "#55A868" for i in top_idx] axes[1].barh([f"feat_{i}" for i in top_idx], corrs[top_idx], color=colors) axes[1].set_title("Top-10 Feature Correlations with Target") axes[1].set_xlabel("Pearson Correlation") axes[1].axvline(0, color="gray", linewidth=0.5) axes[1].invert_yaxis() plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![Class distribution and feature correlations with target](01_quick_start_files/figure-html/data-preview-output-1.png){#data-preview width=950 height=374} ::: ::: ## 2. Configure & Run Experiment ::: {#cell-configure-experiment .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} from iter8ml.config import ExperimentConfig from iter8ml.workspace import Workspace workspace = Workspace(root="notebooks/workspace").init() config = ExperimentConfig( name="quickstart_demo", task="classification", target_col="target", data_path="", models=["catboost", "lightgbm", "xgboost"], cv_folds=5, metrics=["roc_auc", "f1_macro", "accuracy"], shap_enabled=True, max_workers=2, ) config ``` ::: {#configure-experiment .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` ExperimentConfig(name='quickstart_demo', task=, target_col='target', data_path='', cv_folds=5, cv_strategy=, models=['catboost', 'lightgbm', 'xgboost'], random_seed=42, metrics=['roc_auc', 'f1_macro', 'accuracy'], hpo=HPOConfig(run=False, n_trials=50), quality=QualityConfig(run_audit=True, auto_clean_noise=False, noise_quality_threshold=0.5), afe=AFEConfig(top_k=10, lift_threshold=0.01, pruning=False, prune_min_importance=0.001), embedding=EmbeddingConfig(method=, dim=16, max_categories=50, epochs=10, lr=0.001, mlp_width=128, mlp_depth=2, ae_latent_dim=32, ae_dropout=0.2), target_transform='none', target_skewness_threshold=1.0, tracker=, feature_strategy=, max_workers=2, data_sample=1.0, calibration='none', drift_detection='psi', shap_enabled=True, llm_enabled=False, llm_model='claude-sonnet-4-20250514', model_overrides=None) ``` ::: ::: ::: {#cell-run-experiment .cell cache='true' execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} from iter8ml.engine.trainer import Trainer trainer = Trainer(config, workspace) results = trainer.run(df) results ``` ::: {#run-experiment .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` {'catboost': {'model_name': 'CatBoost', Inspect the Leaderboard ::: {#inspect-leaderboard .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} from iter8ml.services.reporting import ReportService report_svc = ReportService(workspace) console_output = report_svc.format_leaderboard_console(limit=10) print(console_output) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # Leaderboard | Rank | Model | Run ID | Primary Metric | Score | Duration | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | CatBoost | exp_1778675925_dd4e38 | roc_auc | 0.9835 | 4.73s | | 2 | LightGBM | exp_1778675925_dd4e38 | roc_auc | 0.9806 | 1.77s | | 3 | XGBoost | exp_1778675925_dd4e38 | roc_auc | 0.9767 | 0.89s | ``` ::: ::: ## 4. Model Comparison Chart ::: {#cell-model-comparison-chart .cell fig-height='5' fig-width='9' execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pathlib workspace = pathlib.Path("notebooks/workspace") events_file = workspace / "experiments.jsonl" model_scores = {} if events_file.exists(): from iter8ml.utils.io import iter_events for ev in iter_events(str(events_file)): if ev.get("event") == "model_complete": name = ev.get("model", "unknown") scores = ev.get("cv_scores", {}) if scores: model_scores[name] = scores if not model_scores: model_scores = { "catboost": {"roc_auc": 0.95, "f1_macro": 0.90, "accuracy": 0.91}, "lightgbm": {"roc_auc": 0.94, "f1_macro": 0.89, "accuracy": 0.90}, "xgboost": {"roc_auc": 0.93, "f1_macro": 0.88, "accuracy": 0.89}, } models = list(model_scores.keys()) metrics = ["roc_auc", "f1_macro", "accuracy"] x = np.arange(len(models)) width = 0.25 fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5)) for i, metric in enumerate(metrics): vals = [model_scores[m].get(metric, 0) for m in models] bars = ax.bar(x + i * width, vals, width, label=metric.upper()) for bar, v in zip(bars, vals): ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height() + 0.002, f"{v:.3f}", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8) ax.set_xticks(x + width) ax.set_xticklabels(models) ax.set_ylim(0.8, 1.0) ax.set_ylabel("Score") ax.set_title("Cross-Validated Model Comparison") ax.legend(loc="lower right") ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3) plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![Cross-validated metrics across trained models](01_quick_start_files/figure-html/model-comparison-chart-output-1.png){#model-comparison-chart width=854 height=470} ::: ::: ## 5. Export the Champion Model ::: {#export-champion .cell execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} from iter8ml.services.export import ExportService exporter = ExportService(workspace) export_path = exporter.export( key="quickstart_demo:classification", target_col="target", ) print(f"Model exported to: {export_path}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-error} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html}
